asked.item: Can't find Fix My Automation button on Make.com failed request
Is the button hidden on my plan?
What to do instead for Make.com

verdict.reason: The pages say Fix My Automation is n8n only and does not work for Make.com, and they point to the manual checklist instead.

steps.text: The Fix My Automation feature is n8n only, and it does not work for Make.com.
For Make.com, use the manual troubleshooting checklist instead.
In the checklist, check your Logs and click any request to see the full payload, error response, and which account it was sent to.
